versos.grego: Πρεσβυτέρῳ μὴ ἐπιπλήξῃς, ἀλλὰ παρακάλει ὡς πατέρα, νεωτέρους ὡς ἀδελφούς,

controles.web: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
controles.kjv: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
controles.livre: Não repreendas ao idoso asperamente, mas exorta-o como a um pai; aos jovens, como a irmãos;

versos.grego: πρεσβυτέρας ὡς μητέρας, νεωτέρας ὡς ἀδελφὰς ἐν πάσῃ ἁγνείᾳ.

controles.web: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
controles.kjv: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
controles.livre: às idosas, como a mães; e às moças, como a irmãs, em toda pureza.

versos.grego: Χήρας τίμα τὰς ὄντως χήρας.

controles.web: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
controles.kjv: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
controles.livre: Honra as viúvas que são verdadeiramente viúvas.

versos.grego: εἰ δέ τις χήρα τέκνα ἢ ἔκγονα ἔχει, μανθανέτωσαν πρῶτον τὸν ἴδιον οἶκον εὐσεβεῖν καὶ ἀμοιβὰς ἀποδιδόναι τοῖς προγόνοις· τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety towards their own family, and to repay their parents, for this is  acceptable in the sight of God.
controles.kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
controles.livre: Mas, se alguma viúva tiver filhos ou netos, aprendam primeiro a exercer piedade com a sua própria família,  e a recompensar os seus pais; porque isso é agradável diante de Deus.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ ὄντως χήρα καὶ μεμονωμένη ἤλπικεν ἐπὶ Θεὸν καὶ προσμένει ταῖς δεήσεσιν καὶ ταῖς προσευχαῖς νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας·

controles.web: Now she who is a widow indeed, and desolate, has her hope set on God, and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
controles.kjv: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
controles.livre: A que é verdadeiramente viúva e desamparada espera em Deus, e persevera noite e dia em rogos e orações.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ σπαταλῶσα ζῶσα τέθνηκεν.

controles.web: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.
controles.kjv: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
controles.livre: Mas a que se entrega aos prazeres, enquanto vive, está morta.

versos.grego: καὶ ταῦτα παράγγελλε, ἵνα ἀνεπίλημπτοι ὦσιν.

controles.web: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.
controles.kjv: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
controles.livre: Manda, pois, essas coisas, para que sejam irrepreensíveis.

versos.grego: εἰ δέ τις τῶν ἰδίων καὶ μάλιστα οἰκείων οὐ προνοεῖ, τὴν πίστιν ἤρνηται καὶ ἔστιν ἀπίστου χείρων.

controles.web: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith, and is worse than an unbeliever.
controles.kjv: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
controles.livre: Porém, se alguém não cuida dos seus, e principalmente dos de sua própria família,  negou a fé, e é pior que um incrédulo.

versos.grego: Χήρα καταλεγέσθω μὴ ἔλαττον ἐτῶν ἑξήκοντα γεγονυῖα, ἑνὸς ἀνδρὸς γυνή,

controles.web: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
controles.kjv: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
controles.livre: A viúva, para ser registrada, não deve ter menos de sessenta anos, e haver sido mulher de um marido.

versos.grego: ἐν ἔργοις καλοῖς μαρτυρουμένη, εἰ ἐτεκνοτρόφησεν, εἰ ἐξενοδόχησεν, εἰ ἁγίων πόδας ἔνιψεν, εἰ θλιβομένοις ἐπήρκεσεν, εἰ παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ ἐπηκολούθησεν.

controles.web: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.
controles.kjv: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
controles.livre: Ela deve ter testemunho de boas obras: se criou filhos, se foi hospitaleira, se lavou os pés dos santos, se socorreu os aflitos, se seguiu toda boa obra.

versos.grego: νεωτέρας δὲ χήρας παραιτοῦ· ὅταν γὰρ καταστρηνιάσωσιν τοῦ Χριστοῦ, γαμεῖν θέλουσιν,

controles.web: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry;
controles.kjv: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
controles.livre: Mas não admitas as viúvas jovens; porque, quando têm desejos sensuais contra Cristo, querem se casar;

versos.grego: ἔχουσαι κρίμα ὅτι τὴν πρώτην πίστιν ἠθέτησαν·

controles.web: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
controles.kjv: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
controles.livre: e têm condenação, por haverem anulado a primeira fé.

versos.grego: ἅμα δὲ καὶ ἀργαὶ μανθάνουσιν, περιερχόμεναι τὰς οἰκίας, οὐ μόνον δὲ ἀργαὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ φλύαροι καὶ περίεργοι, λαλοῦσαι τὰ μὴ δέοντα.

controles.web: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
controles.kjv: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
controles.livre: E, além disso, também aprendem a andar ociosas de casa em casa; e não somente ociosas, mas também fofoqueiras e curiosas, falando o que não se deve.

versos.grego: βούλομαι οὖν νεωτέρας γαμεῖν, τεκνογονεῖν, οἰκοδεσποτεῖν, μηδεμίαν ἀφορμὴν διδόναι τῷ ἀντικειμένῳ λοιδορίας χάριν·

controles.web: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.
controles.kjv: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
controles.livre: Por isso, quero que as mais jovens se casem, gerem filhos, administrem a casa, e não deem nenhuma oportunidade ao adversário de maldizer.

versos.grego: ἤδη γάρ τινες ἐξετράπησαν ὀπίσω τοῦ Σατανᾶ.

controles.web: For already some have turned aside after Satan.
controles.kjv: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
controles.livre: Pois algumas já se desviaram e seguiram Satanás.

versos.grego: εἴ τις πιστὴ ἔχει χήρας, ἐπαρκείτω αὐταῖς, καὶ μὴ βαρείσθω ἡ ἐκκλησία, ἵνα ταῖς ὄντως χήραις ἐπαρκέσῃ.

controles.web: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened; that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.
controles.kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
controles.livre: Se alguma crente tem viúvas, que as ajude, e não sobrecarregue a igreja, para que ela possa ajudar as que são de verdade viúvas.

versos.grego: Οἱ καλῶς προεστῶτες πρεσβύτεροι διπλῆς τιμῆς ἀξιούσθωσαν, μάλιστα οἱ κοπιῶντες ἐν λόγῳ καὶ διδασκαλίᾳ.

controles.web: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
controles.kjv: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
controles.livre: Os presbíteros ou: anciãos que lideram bem sejam estimados como dignos de honra dobrada, principalmente os que trabalham na palavra e na doutrina.

versos.grego: λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφή Βοῦν ἀλοῶντα οὐ φιμώσεις, καί Ἄξιος ὁ ἐργάτης τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”
controles.kjv: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
controles.livre: Pois a Escritura diz: “Ao boi que debulha não atarás a boca”;  e: “o trabalhador é digno do seu salário”.

versos.grego: κατὰ πρεσβυτέρου κατηγορίαν μὴ παραδέχου, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ ἐπὶ δύο ἢ τριῶν μαρτύρων.

controles.web: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder, except at the word of two or three witnesses.
controles.kjv: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
controles.livre: Não aceites acusação contra um presbítero, a não ser com duas ou três testemunhas.

versos.grego: Τοὺς ἁμαρτάνοντας ἐνώπιον πάντων ἔλεγχε, ἵνα καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ φόβον ἔχωσιν.

controles.web: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
controles.kjv: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
controles.livre: Aos que pecarem, repreende-os na presença de todos, para que os outros também tenham temor.

versos.grego: διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν ἀγγέλων ἵνα ταῦτα φυλάξῃς χωρὶς προκρίματος, μηδὲν ποιῶν κατὰ πρόσκλισιν.

controles.web: I command you in the sight of God, and Christ Jesus, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.
controles.kjv: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
controles.livre: Ordeno-te, diante de Deus, de Cristo Jesus, e dos anjos escolhidos, que guardes essas coisas sem preconceitos, fazendo nada por favoritismo.

versos.grego: Χεῖρας ταχέως μηδενὶ ἐπιτίθει, μηδὲ κοινώνει ἁμαρτίαις ἀλλοτρίαις· σεαυτὸν ἁγνὸν τήρει.

controles.web: Lay hands hastily on no one, neither be a participant in other men’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
controles.kjv: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.
controles.livre: A ninguém imponhas as mãos apressadamente, nem participes dos pecados alheios; conserva-te puro.

versos.grego: Μηκέτι ὑδροπότει, ἀλλὰ οἴνῳ ὀλίγῳ χρῶ διὰ τὸν στόμαχον καὶ τὰς πυκνάς σου ἀσθενείας.

controles.web: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
controles.kjv: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach’s sake and thine often infirmities.
controles.livre: Não bebas mais somente água, mas usa também de um pouco de vinho, por causa do teu estômago, e das tuas frequentes enfermidades.

versos.grego: Τινῶν ἀνθρώπων αἱ ἁμαρτίαι πρόδηλοί εἰσιν προάγουσαι εἰς κρίσιν, τισὶν δὲ καὶ ἐπακολουθοῦσιν·

controles.web: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.
controles.kjv: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
controles.livre: Os pecados de algumas pessoas são evidentes antes mesmo do juízo, mas os de algumas são manifestos depois.

versos.grego: ὡσαύτως καὶ τὰ ἔργα τὰ καλὰ πρόδηλα, καὶ τὰ ἄλλως ἔχοντα κρυβῆναι οὐ δύνανται.

controles.web: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.
controles.kjv: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
controles.livre: Semelhantemente, também, as boas obras são evidentes; e as que não são assim não se podem esconder.
